title: Programiz: Find Largest Among Three Numbers
description: Given three numbers `a`, `b`, and `c`, find and return the largest.
starter_code:
def largest_among_three(a: int, b: int, c: int) -> int:
    pass
solution:
def largest_among_three(a: int, b: int, c: int) -> int:
    return max(a, b, c)
explanation: Compares 3 operands returning maximum in O(1) time.
